string-array.name: stage_story
string-array.item: Five minutes before the weekly meeting,\nhe walks in holding your proposal:\n"Wasn\'t this my idea first?"
"Oh, I don\'t really work anymore —\nmy father-in-law gave us a building."\nThat\'s the third time he\'s flashed his car key.
She starts before you can swallow.\n"Got a job yet? Married yet?\nThe neighbour\'s kid has two kids already."
They swore it was a quiet building.\nSomeone is dribbling on your ceiling,\nand they are keeping the beat.

string-array.name: stage_clear
string-array.item: The boss is off on holiday next week.
He paid for the second round.\nYou win tonight.
Auntie left for her evening drama.\nThis is your chance.
They finally put down a floor mat.\nPeace at last.

string-array.name: stage_fail
string-array.item: Your proposal went up under his name.
On the way home you reread your lease.
The Lunar New Year trailer just dropped.
3 a.m. You are staring at the ceiling.
